name: Wield Probe (research)
description: Research only, for W's King of Hearts: can a mod put a GL-21 in your Helldiver's hands, fill it to 40 rounds and give your own weapon back? Logs the game's weapon switches; In a mission, Insert drops a GL-21 at your feet: pick it up by hand, switch weapons, drop it; Delete removes it. Solo or host. Turn off when done.
